/* * Runtime resolver for the transpiled GT6 chemistry data ({@link GTChemGen}). * *

Recipes whose materials/fluids are absent in the port are skipped and * counted — GT6 behaved the same way for missing cross-mod content. */

root_comment_corrections: Chemical class summary describes current helper quantities and separately loaded generated data; removes unverified remaining recipe count.
Resolver class summary no longer assumes every unresolved token is approved permanently absent optional content.
Resolver loadAll names the actual MachineRecipeBootstrap caller, not an old loader name.
Resolver added counts non-null map registration results; skipped includes map rejection as well as resolution. This differs from loaders that count submissions.
limits: Every executable token and literal position unchanged for each native platform, including imports, FQN expressions, null/caching/exception behavior and table order.
Agent sharing proofs describe intermediate comments; root final source/view hashes and exact execution checks are recorded separately after comment corrections.
Baseline four full-body candidates are now shared; unreviewed method-level duplication, large responsibilities, native interfaces and all gameplay coverage remain separate.
No generators, Gradle, compilation, new tests, Java initialization, runtime recipe registry, game, build, push or behavior fixes.
